title: openai-chat-completions-parity: streaming stability, function-calls, roles/stop/logprobs response formatting
author: Avery Chen
release_notes: Improved OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity: streaming stability fixes, function-calling consistency, role/stop/logprobs handling, and response formatting improvements. Backcompat preserved for existing Redwood API. See docs for migration notes.
description: Context: This PR completes a cross-repo effort to bring Redwood's OpenAI /v1/chat.completions compatibility layer to parity for a set of features requested by service integrations: more stable streaming behavior, consistent function/tool-calling semantics, correct handling of role tokens and stop sequences, explicit logprobs in legacy mode, and deterministic response formatting for structured outputs. Motivation: Customers using the OpenAI compatibility endpoint observed edge cases where streaming chunks duplicated role delimiters, function call payloads were inconsistently emitted, and stop/logprobs were misaligned with the token stream, leading to integration breakages. Scope: 1) Streaming runtime fixes to avoid duplicated role prefixes and to ensure chunk boundaries don't split JSON tool payloads; 2) Function/tool-calling: normalize the signal that indicates a function call vs text content and emit a single final function_call event in streaming mode; 3) Roles/stop/logprobs: compute and attach logprobs consistently in both streaming and non-streaming paths and ensure stop sequences are enforced without emitting partial trailing tokens; 4) Response formatting: canonicalize structured outputs (json-schema and assistant.function_call fields) to match OpenAI shapes, including deterministic ordering for keys used in E2E tests. Implementation notes: changes touch the compatibility layer, streaming muxer, tokenizer boundary logic, SDK shims (Python/TS/Go) and end-to-end tests. Backwards compatibility: kept previous Redwood-specific fields under the x-redwood-* header for one release, added feature flag openai_parity_v1 to allow rollout. Testing: added new integration tests that exercise streaming + function calls, regression tests derived from customer reports, and fuzz tests for tokenizer boundaries. Checklist: - [x] Runtime streaming patch applied and benchmarked - [x] Function-calling event model normalized - [x] logprobs fixed for both streaming/non-streaming - [x] Added integration tests and e2e fixtures - [x] Docs updated with migration notes - [x] Feature-flag gated rollout and smoke rollout in production Observability: emitted new metrics stream.chunk_dedup, openai_compat.function_calls_emitted, and parity.response_mismatch_count (used for post-merge monitoring). Related: ENG-4123 for rollout plan, ENG-4189 for integration test matrix.
